title: Coil d20 on XY (centre 3, -2), 4 turns, height 20, angle -10: it narrows as it rises

expect.note: Circle d2 inside d20: its centre at r 9 on the plane, 9 - 20 tan 10 at the top; Pappus with the mean radius 9 - 10 tan 10: V = pi x 2 pi x 4 x (9 - 10 tan 10). FreeCAD's helix only widens away from its section (a negative angle gave the mirror image below the plane): SciForge sweeps it from the narrow end. The helix is an approximation, hence rel_tol 1e-4.
